implementerProof.how: Re-ran every claim of the round-2 implement handoff on the real surface rather than reading it. Finding 1 (octal): `maxInputChars = 032000`, `= 017000`, `= 0032000` and `DISPATCH_BODY_MAX = 032000`, each written into a scratch tree holding the repository's own files with the real script symlinked in, now exit 1 with `declares no <const> this check can read: no line matches ^…(0|[1-9][0-9]*)…` naming a leading zero in its enumeration; the unmodified tree still exits 0, so the tighter class refuses the octal shape without refusing the real one. Finding 2 (false refusal): a trailing same-line comment carrying the pairing with nothing above it now passes, and the breadth control holds — a trailing comment naming nothing still exits 1, and the pairing moved to a *preceding* const member's comment still exits 1 naming the site, so the wider walk did not become a weaker rule in that direction. Error model: a directory in place of embed.go prints one `::error file=…::… cannot be read: [Errno 21] Is a directory: …` with no traceback (the exact shape I reported as an observation in round 1), a mode-000 file prints the Errno 13 equivalent, and the listable findings still accumulate — a tree with both cross-references and one AGENTS.md line removed prints three `::error file=…` lines and `::error::3 problem(s)`. A form feed above the declaration reports the line `awk` counts. Round-1 behaviour is unregressed: 64000, a lowered embedder limit, hex, digit separators and an expression all still fail; both limits raised together, CRLF and a trailing `//` comment still pass. The implement handoff's four proof entries each carry six non-empty fields. What its proof does not cover is the failure below, which the same fix introduced.

failures.criterion: Acceptance 2: whoever reads either number learns that the other exists — held by machine, so the check must refuse a tree whose declaration comment does not name the other constant.
failures.evidence: Fail-open in the widened `attached_comment` (.github/scripts/check-body-embed-limit.sh:118-144, commit 5229534fb656): the walk tests `stripped.endswith("*/")` before `stripped.startswith("//")`, so an ordinary `//` line whose text happens to end with `*/` is taken for a block comment's closing line. The inner loop then consumes upward looking for an opening `/*` and, when the file holds none, appends every line above the declaration to the credited block — the whole file, code included. A mention of the other constant anywhere above, attached to nothing, then satisfies the cross-reference. Reproduced at c28c6dd7 on a tree holding the repository's own embed.go with its pairing sentence removed, a natural comment line `// Deprecated spelling of this comment was a block: /* bounds one text */` directly above the declaration, and `// Historical note: DISPATCH_BODY_MAX was raised in INFRA-45. Attached to nothing.` planted on line 1: the check exits 0 and prints `body limit 32000 (…:213) fits the embedder's 32000 (…:50), and each names the other`, which is false of that tree. This is the mirror of review finding 2 — that fix traded a false refusal for a false acceptance — and it is the same class as review finding 1: the gate reports agreement it has not established. Red test: `.github/scripts/check-body-embed-limit.test.sh`, case `a // comment line that ends with */ above the declaration` (commit 0c5d413f), which builds the TS side of the same shape and requires exit 1 naming `the comment above DISPATCH_BODY_MAX (packages/contracts/src/dispatch-tools.ts:6) does not name maxInputChars`. It fails at this head: `cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && .github/scripts/check-body-embed-limit.test.sh` reports `FAIL: exits 1`, `FAIL: does not credit a mention attached to nothing far above` and `Results: 59 passed, 2 failed`, exit 1, with every other case still passing. Ordering the `//` branch before the `*/` branch, and refusing (or not crediting) a block whose opening `/*` is never found, is what the test asks for; the test itself is not the implementer's to change.

The cross-reference walk refuses what it should in the directions I could reach other than the one above: a pairing moved to a preceding const member's comment, a trailing comment naming nothing, a blank line between a naming comment and the declaration.

observations: Not a failure, recorded because the next round touches the same function: `attached_comment` makes a `const (` opener transparent, so a Go doc comment on a one-member group reaches its member. Where the declaration is the *first* member of a many-member group, a package-level comment above `const (` is credited to it. That is the shape review finding 2 asked for and I could not turn it into a false pass — a previous member of the group stops the walk, which is what keeps the real embed.go honest.

Unchanged from round 1 and still out of scope: an ask's embedded text is `question || ' ' || coalesce(answer->>'text','')` and a document's markdown is cut at the same limit with the same silence (dispatch://INFRA-114 owns both); the generated copies of the cap are held by `bun run check:go` in a job main's ruleset does not require.
